tagline.zh: 一条可拖的分隔条把界面分成可调双栏:拖拽与方向键共用同一数值,栏内组件用容器查询随栏宽自适应——IDE、邮件客户端与文档站的骨架。
tagline.en: A draggable divider splits the UI into two resizable panes: drag and arrow keys drive one shared value, while container queries re-flow pane content — the backbone of IDEs, mail clients and docs sites.

origin.zh: CSS 无原生可拖拽分栏标准(调研 05§8);生态事实标准是 React 生态的 react-resizable-panels:PanelGroup/Panel 组件分组、拖拽手柄、支持 WAI-ARIA separator 角色的键盘可访问性(方向键调整,README 一手核对)。MDN Cookbook 的「Split navigation」是视觉分隔的导航配方,与桌面式可拖分栏并非同一概念,注意区分(调研 05§8)。本条目 demo 以原生 Pointer Events + role="separator" 复刻同一模式,零第三方库。
origin.en: CSS has no native draggable split-pane standard (research 05 §8); the ecosystem de-facto standard is react-resizable-panels in the React world: PanelGroup/Panel grouping, a drag handle, and WAI-ARIA separator-role keyboard support (arrow keys, README verified first-hand). MDN Cookbook's 'Split navigation' is a visually divided nav recipe, not the same concept as desktop-style resizable panes (research 05 §8). This entry's demo recreates the same pattern with native Pointer Events + role="separator", no third-party library.

effect.zh: 左栏初始宽度占分栏容器百分比(CSS 型 --sv-start,拖拽手柄实时回写 store,滑杆与拖拽双向同步)。默认 40% 为演示基准值,未证实——react-resizable-panels 的 defaultSize 按各产品自定,无统一官方值;双击分隔条回到该值。
effect.en: The left pane's initial width as a percentage of the split container (CSS-type --sv-start; the drag handle writes back to the store so slider and drag stay in sync). Default 40% is a demo baseline value, unverified — react-resizable-panels defaultSize is product-specific with no single official value; double-click the divider to restore it.

effect.zh: 拖拽与方向键的夹紧下限(JS 型,同时写入分隔条的 aria-valuemin)。默认 20% 为演示基准值,未证实;低于该下限的栏内容应折叠而不是被压碎——demo 用容器查询在右栏过窄时把卡片翻成纵排。
effect.en: The clamp floor for drag and arrow keys (JS-type; also written to the divider's aria-valuemin). Default 20% is a demo baseline value, unverified; pane content should collapse rather than be crushed below the floor — the demo uses a container query to stack the right card when it gets too narrow.

note.zh: 本条目 demo 依赖的 Pointer Events、role="separator" 与容器查询均为广泛可用能力;容器查询 Baseline Widely available 自 2023-02(调研 05§6)。分栏本身无 CSS 原生标准——生态方案 react-resizable-panels 的兼容性随 React 走(调研 05§8)。
note.en: What the demo relies on — Pointer Events, role="separator" and container queries — is broadly available; container queries are Baseline Widely available since 2023-02 (research 05 §6). Split panes have no native CSS standard — the ecosystem solution react-resizable-panels inherits React's compatibility surface (research 05 §8).

fallback.zh: 不支持拖拽/指针事件的环境(键盘、读屏)必须保留方向键等价操作——role="separator" + tabindex + 方向键是 WAI-ARIA separator 模式的最低配(调研 05§8);极窄视口放弃分栏,改上下堆叠(媒体查询先于分栏生效);容器查询不生效时栏内组件保持默认纵排,不报错。
fallback.en: Environments without drag/pointer support (keyboard, screen readers) must keep an arrow-key equivalent — role="separator" + tabindex + arrow keys is the WAI-ARIA separator minimum (research 05 §8); on very narrow viewports drop the split and stack vertically (media queries take precedence); where container queries are unsupported, pane content keeps its default stacked layout without errors.

use.zh: IDE/编辑器的资源树与编辑区、邮件客户端的列表与阅读 pane
use.en: IDE file trees beside editors, mail clients' list beside the reading pane

use.zh: 文档站/后台的侧栏导航,用户可按自己的屏幕宽度收窄
use.en: Docs sites and admin sidebars users can narrow to taste

use.zh: 对比场景:图集编辑器原图与调色结果并排、日志查看器
use.en: Comparison surfaces: image editors side-by-side, log viewers

use.zh: 栏内组件密度自适应——配合容器查询让卡片随栏宽自行重排(本条目 demo 的联动)
use.en: Density adaptation inside panes — container queries re-flow cards as the pane narrows (this demo's linkage)

avoid.zh: 手机竖屏主界面——拇指拖拽分隔条误触率高,直接堆叠
avoid.en: Phone-portrait primary UIs — thumb-dragging a divider is error-prone; just stack

avoid.zh: 内容必须完整可见的场景(报表、表单)——分栏挤压会截断关键信息
avoid.en: Content that must be fully visible (reports, forms) — squeezing panes truncates key info

avoid.zh: 把 MDN Cookbook「Split navigation」(导航分组视觉分隔)当成可拖分栏——两者不是同一概念(调研 05§8)
avoid.en: Mistaking MDN Cookbook's 'Split navigation' (visually divided nav) for resizable panes — different concepts (research 05 §8)

avoid.zh: 分隔条只做鼠标目标——无键盘等价操作违反 WCAG 2.1.1(调研 05§8 的 separator 模式正是为此)
avoid.en: Dividers as mouse-only targets — no keyboard equivalent violates WCAG 2.1.1 (the separator pattern in research 05 §8 exists for exactly this)

a11y.zh: 分隔条是 WAI-ARIA separator:role="separator"、tabindex=0、aria-orientation="vertical"、aria-valuenow/min/max 实时反映栏宽、方向键调整(调研 05§8 react-resizable-panels README 同款语义);拖拽中 aria-valuenow 同步更新;夹紧下限防止任一栏被压到内容不可达;面板重排只改视觉不改 DOM 顺序(WCAG 1.3.2);焦点环在分隔条上清晰可见;prefers-reduced-motion 下取消面板宽度过渡。
a11y.en: The divider is a WAI-ARIA separator: role="separator", tabindex=0, aria-orientation="vertical", aria-valuenow/min/max tracking the pane width live, arrow keys to adjust (same semantics as react-resizable-panels' README, research 05 §8); aria-valuenow updates during drag; the clamp floor keeps either pane's content reachable; pane re-flow changes visuals only, never DOM order (WCAG 1.3.2); a visible focus ring sits on the divider; pane-width transitions are dropped under prefers-reduced-motion.

goal.zh: 用原生 Pointer Events + WAI-ARIA separator 模式复刻一个可拖双栏:左栏文件树、右栏预览卡,分隔条可拖拽、可方向键微调、双击复位,右栏内容用容器查询随栏宽翻转横纵排。
goal.en: Recreate a draggable two-pane split with native Pointer Events + the WAI-ARIA separator pattern: a file tree left, a preview card right; the divider drags, arrow-keys nudge, double-click resets, and the right pane's content flips row/column via a container query.

acceptance.zh: 分隔条 role="separator"、tabindex=0、aria-orientation="vertical",aria-valuenow/min/max 随拖拽实时更新
acceptance.en: Divider carries role="separator", tabindex=0, aria-orientation="vertical", with aria-valuenow/min/max live during drag

acceptance.zh: 拖拽与方向键共用同一夹紧逻辑(minSize 下限),鼠标与键盘结果一致
acceptance.en: Drag and arrow keys share one clamping rule (minSize floor); mouse and keyboard produce identical results

acceptance.zh: 右栏声明 container-type: inline-size,查询条件为字面量断点,窄栏自动翻成纵排
acceptance.en: The right pane declares container-type: inline-size with a literal breakpoint, stacking the card when narrow

acceptance.zh: 双击分隔条恢复 startSize 参数值;极窄视口退化为上下堆叠
acceptance.en: Double-clicking the divider restores the startSize parameter; very narrow viewports degrade to stacked layout

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion 下取消宽度过渡动画
acceptance.en: Width transitions are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
